definite_findings.title: Cancelled request can commit into current visible preview
evidence: NewsFeedView.swift:978–984 unconditionally assigns awaited optional to @State
NewsFeedView.swift:1396–1411 worker cancellation returns nil after waiting
NewsFeedView.swift:1230–1235 loader returns nil to cancelled caller
definite_findings.scenario: Same FeedAsyncMediaFrame identity changes A→B. A detached synchronous work is still finishing; SwiftUI cancels A. B finishes (for example cache hit) and commits image B. A then observes cancellation, returns nil, and its still-live closure assigns nil over B. No post-await cancellation/generation gate exists. A successful result racing cancellation can also commit. This is a legal static ordering, not an observed UI reproduction.
definite_findings.impact: Current photo/video/PDF/teaser shows fallback or mismatched old asset after supersession; initial loading may retain previous image.
definite_findings.target: Only the active, non-cancelled request may commit visible state.
definite_findings.fix: Capture awaited result, guard !Task.isCancelled immediately before assignment on UI actor. Independently stop cancelled loader before image conversion/cache insert. Decide pending-image clearing from existing intended presentation, avoid unrelated architecture.
definite_findings.check: Parent authorized deterministic delayed A/cached B, cancelled A nil/success, disappear/reappear, nil/invalid B scenarios; both hosts type/build check if patched. No check executed here.

definite_findings.title: Video thumbnail and retained image cost lack a decoded resource envelope
evidence: NewsFeedView.swift:1297–1305 AVAssetImageGenerator sets transform but no maximumSize
NewsFeedView.swift:1237–1253 image bytes converted to CGImage/UIImage under MainActor
NewsFeedView.swift:1267 image path already limits maxPixelSize1200; PDF raster bounds1343–1346
definite_findings.scenario: A published high-resolution local video goes straight through full frame generation, PNG encoding, MainActor image creation and shared cache. Entry count alone does not bound bytes when a single frame has no maximum dimensions.
definite_findings.impact: Avoidable allocation/encode/decode cost and large retained objects in repeated media previews. Actual memory pressure, jank or crash not established.
definite_findings.target: Bound generated video preview pixel size; account decoded cache cost with an app-owned budget.
definite_findings.fix: Set generator.maximumSize using the existing preview pixel envelope; set NSCache per-object decoded cost and owner-selected totalCostLimit. Keep detached worker and kind-specific semantics; no speculative new package.
definite_findings.check: Parent permitted high-resolution video, many unique previews, repeated cancellation/navigation and memory-pressure eviction in iPhone Simulator18.2/27; both affected hosts compile if changed. No measured performance claim.

Do not infer gallery omission from items.first: current card semantics explicitly preserved.
Do not invent mandatory failure toast/retry for thumbnail nil; established fallback exists.
Do not label max count160 unbounded object count, or claim exact physical memory retained; count bounded, byte envelope absent.
